Five Star will package your fish in either 3 or 5 mil bags. The thicker 5 mil bags are preferable for long term storage and shipping. All prices are based on the whole weight of the fish.

Please note that fish under 10 pounds are subject to a different price schedule as they require substantially more time and effort to process.

3 MIL. BAGS

$1.8711⁄100 per pound for fillet and vacuum packaging
$2.8586⁄100 per pound for smoking and vacuum packaging
$3.8981⁄100 per pound for jerking and vacuum packaging

5 MIL. BAGS

$1.9751⁄100 per pound for fillet and vacuum packaging
$5.1975⁄100 per a piece for Collars - Yellowtail Collars, Grouper Collars etc.

Gourmet Canning

$5.7155⁄100 per pound

TUNA BELLIES ARE PROVIDED AUTOMATICALLY AT NO ADDITIONAL CHARGE- All other bellies by special request only

We are happy to accept fillets at an increased rate of $3.6383⁄100 per pound.

Gill 'n Gut service is available at a rate of $1.5593⁄100 per pound.

Collars are packed only in 5 mil bags and must be requested in your order.

All Wahoo will have skin removed unless you request that it be left on.

Wahoo "bone in" Steaks will only be packaged in 5 Mil bags

All Credit Card Transactions include a 3.95% service fee.

Keep in mind the integrity of the bags may be compromised due to bones in collars and bone in steaks.
